title: Attachment
description: One immutable record for a file a person sent in chat. The bytes live below the household data directory; this record carries only their per-person ownership, turn provenance, integrity and retention policy.

id.description: Stable attachment id, never reused. The id is also the basename used by the storage path.

owner_person_id.description: The signed-in person who sent the file. Ownership is captured at write time and is not inferred from a later profile change.

conversation_id.description: The conversation that received the file.

turn_id.description: The turn whose user message carried the file.

media_type.description: Normalized MIME media type supplied to the attachment pipeline, without parameters.

size.description: Exact byte length of the stored file.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the stored bytes, used to verify a read never changed the upload.

storage_path.description: A normalized relative path below the household data directory. Implementations place it under people/{owner_person_id}/attachments/ and reject traversal or absolute paths.

retention.description: The file follows the owning conversation's household.conversation_retention_days setting, currently 7-365 days with a 90-day default. It is deleted with the owning turn and immediately by host.data.forget(person); it has no longer-lived attachment retention class.

provenance.description: How this record entered the hub, such as composer:upload. It identifies the local path through the turn and adapter, not a remote service.

hlc.description: Hybrid logical clock for the immutable record, matching the shared record envelope.
